name: Content Control Character Bible V1
identity_rule: Capture reference mechanics and animation grammar, never reproduce another creator's exact character identity, signature costume, face, logo, or unique design.

global_design.limb_style: two-segment jointed limbs with visible elbows/knees on action poses
global_design.eyes: small black dots; widen/separate only for shock

dave.silhouette: round head, slightly forward shoulders, medium limbs
dave.motion_signature: fast anticipation, oversized recoil, two-beat recovery
dave.comedy_function: makes the financially tempting mistake the viewer recognizes
dave.voice: slightly faster and more emotional than narrator

points_monk.silhouette: upright spine, slightly taller than Dave, economical limbs
points_monk.motion_signature: minimal anticipation followed by one decisive exaggerated action

cashback_goblin.silhouette: small body, oversized head, short bent limbs
cashback_goblin.motion_signature: rapid 3-5 frame pops, zig-zag travel, squash on impacts
cashback_goblin.comedy_function: turns incentives into a visible antagonist
cashback_goblin.voice: optional chirps only; never narrator voice

continuity_requirements: same core expression vocabulary across episodes
signature pose appears before inventing a new pose when equivalent emotion exists
new costume/prop does not alter base silhouette
character role and voice remain stable
rendered-frame QA compares identity against character reference frames
